stories.title: When Zero Was Born in India
stories.description: An Indian mathematician walks through history, explaining how zero was invented in India and changed the world.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of the SAME ancient Indian mathematician walking slowly toward the camera along a stone corridor inspired by Nalanda University. Male, early 30s, short beard, calm but confident face, simple cotton robe, holding palm-leaf manuscripts. Speaking directly to the camera while walking.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow forward walk, smooth camera tracking backward at chest height, natural head and hand movement while speaking, stable framing
scenes.narration: हर कोई अंकों को जानता है। एक, दो, तीन। लेकिन इतिहास यह पूछना भूल गया कि शून्य कहाँ से आया।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of the SAME mathematician continuing to walk through an ancient courtyard with stone pillars and scholars behind him. He keeps eye contact with the camera while walking.
scenes.motion_prompt: steady walking pace, smooth camera tracking, subtle background scholar movement
scenes.narration: यह यूरोप से नहीं आया। शून्य का जन्म यहीं हुआ — भारत में।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of the mathematician walking and gesturing gently with one hand. Ancient mathematical markings carved faintly on stone walls.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow walk, natural hand gestures while explaining, camera steady and centered
scenes.narration: शून्य से पहले, संख्याएँ चीज़ों को गिन सकती थीं। लेकिन वे ‘कुछ नहीं’ को समझा नहीं सकती थीं।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of the mathematician slowing his walk, facing the camera more directly. Manuscripts and writing tools visible behind him.
scenes.motion_prompt: walk slows almost to a stop, gentle camera settle, subtle head movement
scenes.narration: भारतीय विद्वानों ने शून्य का केवल उपयोग नहीं किया। उन्होंने उसे परिभाषित किया। उसे नियम दिए।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of the mathematician resuming his walk past students studying. He glances at the camera while moving forward.
scenes.motion_prompt: smooth walking motion, steady backward camera tracking, light background activity
scenes.narration: शून्य के बिना न बीजगणित होता, न विज्ञान, और न ही आधुनिक दुनिया।

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of the mathematician walking as the background subtly suggests maps and trade routes carved into stone.
scenes.motion_prompt: continuous forward walk, slow parallax in background, stable framing
scenes.narration: यह विचार भारत से दुनिया तक पहुँचा — धीरे-धीरे, लेकिन सब कुछ बदलते हुए।

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the mathematician stopping his walk and facing the camera directly, warm sunlight touching his face, calm and assured expression.
scenes.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, minimal head movement, steady camera, gentle robe motion
scenes.narration: हर बार जब आप शून्य लिखते हैं, आप भारत की एक खोज का उपयोग कर रहे होते हैं।
